subject: Re: Status: maze repro done, subgoals earn their keep, SV2P is the bottleneck
body:
Team,

Decisions for the home stretch:

1. Bruno escalated and Ines granted a one-week reserved slice of 32 H100s on Vulcan (thanks Ines) - that recovers most of the preemption losses, and the env port now lands 4/28. It did, in fact, land yesterday. Review stays 5/6.
2. The review scope is locked: maze repro numbers (subgoal doubling of planning success at horizon 50, TDM-over-pixel cost on hard layouts) plus the env-port demo. The multi-subgoal (numsg=2) ablation is cut from this window - Carmen's early data says the second subgoal buys little on our layouts and the sweep would eat the reserved slice.
3. Carmen's TDM-filtering trick ships as the default candidate filter, documented in the runbook.
4. Post-review: trajectory datasets to Corpus per Bruno's Q3 schedule, and we pitch continuation funding at the vision portfolio review in June.

Nice recovery on the schedule, everyone.

Lucia
